description: Create a push campaign draft. Content and audience can be set now or later with update_push_campaign; send with send_push_campaign.

body.description: Notification message (max 500 characters; most devices show about 120). Merge tags work.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

iconUrl.description: Optional https icon for web push; defaults to the workspace icon.

imageUrl.description: Optional https image shown in the notification.

localizations.description: Versions in the workspace's other languages (Settings > Localization). Each contact gets the version for their language attribute, else their device language, else the fallback language; languages without a version get the main title and body. Passing it replaces every version ([] removes them). Use translate_push_campaign or translate_push_content to write them with AI.

imageUrl.description: Own image for this language; null uses the main image.

locale.description: Language code, e.g. de, fr or pt-BR.

origin.description: ai for AI translations, manual for ones a person wrote. Manual versions are kept by translate calls unless overwrite is true.

sourceHash.description: Fingerprint of the main copy it was written from; keep the value you read so outdated versions stay detectable.

url.description: Own link for this language; null uses the main link.

platforms.description: Limit delivery to these platforms. Omit (or pass []) to reach every platform the contact has a device on.

targetLists.description: Audience, same shape as campaign targetLists: {"type":"all"}, {"type":"lists","listIds":[...]}, {"type":"segment","segmentId":"..."}, or {"type":"rules","include":[...]}. Only contacts with an active push device receive the campaign.

title.description: Notification title (max 120 characters; most devices show about 40). Merge tags like {{FIRST_NAME|there}} work.

url.description: Link opened on tap: https URL or app deep link (myapp://...). Browsers only open https links. Null clears it.

name: create_push_campaign

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_push_campaign` MCP tool.

campaign.description: The push campaign record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
